baseline.name: opc-openharmony-6.0-release
baseline.display_name: OPC OpenHarmony 6.0 Release (Orange Pi 5 Plus RK3588 port)
baseline.status: P0 in progress — build running on 66 (container oh-build)

kernel.rockchip_layer: kernel_patch/0001-add-rk.patch — GIT LFS, real size 104336293 bytes (sha256:2d852af6b98bbf08ae8ec07dc178bcee4e1ae91c2519e6c87044859cdad131be). Run `git lfs pull` in device/board/opc after repo sync
kernel.note: manifest entry linux_5.10_opi (5.10.160) is VESTIGIAL on the 6.0 branch: no bcmdhd, not used by build_kernel.sh (KERNEL_VERSION=linux-6.6)

baseline.reference_board: Orange Pi 5 Plus (RK3588, same AP6275P wifi_chip_type in dts, RK806 on spi2)
baseline.purpose: source baseline for AGIBOT MB0002 V2 OpenHarmony port; OPC reference images are not flashable on AGIBOT

manifest.system_repo_forks: opc.xml replaces ~15 OH system repos (build, startup_init, drivers_peripheral, graphic_2d, musl, mindspore, ...) with opc forks at OpenHarmony-6.0-Release-opc branches

common_patches.note: 5.0-era blog fixes (init_feature_loader removal, sanitizer gni swap) NOT needed on 6.0: vendor config.json has no init_feature_loader; apply via git apply --check, skip when unappliable

build.entry_script: device/board/opc/opi5plus/kernel/build_kernel.sh (KERNEL_VERSION=linux-6.6, copies board dts into kernel tree, applies kernel_patch incl. hdf.patch + tzdriver/newip/security module patches)

host_requirements.disk_gb_actual: 36+ GB and growing at sync; budget 150 GB
host_requirements.note: 66 has 45 GB total; stop llama-*.service during link window

declgen_ts2sts: pin rimraf 6.0.1 -> 3.0.2 (node14 npm6 + fresh registry resolve drift)

apt: u-boot-tools device-tree-compiler mtools dosfstools squashfs-tools cpio
